modos.descricao: Perguntar tipo de carta e descartar

_metadata.texto_original: Unique.  Animal.  Kinfolk.  Once per turn you may ask a player if he has a specific type of card in his sept hand (e.g. Gift).  If so, he discards one card of that type from his hand.  Oracle of Sobek can use Mokole Gifts.
notas: Descarte direcionado por tipo de carta: requer interacao do usuario
Pode usar Mokole Gifts: restricao de tribo
Mecanica de 'escolher tipo' depende de UI do jogador
